To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the biosynthesis of the outer membrane proteins OmpF and ompC of Escherichiacoli is dependent on the synthesis of phospholipids and that the biosynthesis and/or the assembly of Omps is also dependent on the synthesis and/or the presence of fatty acids.

inhibition of fatty-acids or phospholipids synthesis in Escherichia colicauses a decrease in the amount of OmpF and/or OmpC proteins in the outer membrane, and that this decrease is accompanied by a decrease in the uptake of 50 AMP.
the assembly of OMPs depends upon the availability of lipids and that this dependence is specific for each OMP.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the biosynthesis of the main proteins of the outer membrane, and with their role in the uptake of nutrients.
the role of lipids in the biosynthesis and the assembly of the major outer membrane proteins.
the biosynthesis and the assembly of OMP in E. coli.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

inhibition of fatty acid or phospholipids synthesis affects the biosynthesis and/or the assembly of the major porins OmpF and/or OmpC, and that this is the main reason for the inhibition of the uptake of 3H-labelled 5' AMP.
the biosynthesis or the assembly of porins depends on the availability of lipids.
inhibition of fatty acid or phospholipids biosynthesis in the presence of a non-permissive carbon source, results in a decreased rate of assembly of OmpC and OmpF proteins, respectively.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the biosynthesis of major outer-mem-brane proteins depends on lipid synthesis, and that the incorporation of these proteins into the outer membranes is a lipid-synthesis-independent process.
, whereas the synthesis of phospholipids is required for the assembly of major outer-memban proteins, the synthesis of fatty acids is required for the stability of these proteins.

the biosynthesis of the major outer-membranes proteins is dependent upon the synthesis of the phospholipids and that the assembly of these proteins requires a certain lipid composition of the outer membrane.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesis of phospholipids and fatty acids is necessary for the assembly of major porins in E. coli.
the synthesis of phospholipids is a prerequisite for the biosynthesis of the OMPs.
the synthesis or the biosynthesis of OmpF and of OmpC proteins is dependent upon the presence of a normal lipid composition in the outer membrane of Escherichiacoli.
